techStack: React 19 + TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6 build tool, Vitest 3 + jsdom + @testing-library/react for tests
Strict TS: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch — unused vars/params are compile errors
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — type-only imports must use 'import type'
No path aliases; all imports are plain relative paths
features: BUG 1 (productFilters.ts lines 14-20): sort block runs before any filter step; sort mutates the spread copy then filtering narrows it — sort should run after all filters
BUG 2 (productFilters.ts line 24): search uses product.name.includes(filters.search) — case-sensitive and does not trim whitespace
BUG 3 (FilterPanel.tsx lines 69-74): 'Clear filters' onClick spreads current filters and resets search/category/inStockOnly but never sets sortBy — sort selection persists after clear
Category filter, in-stock filter, and filter combination are already correct — must not regress
Pagination, loading state, error state in useProductFilters.ts are correct — must not be touched
useProductFilters.clearFilters correctly resets to initialFilters (including sortBy: 'default') but FilterPanel's button bypasses it by calling onChange directly
architecture: Data flow: useProductFilters (hook) fetches products; App.tsx calls filterProducts(products, filters) in useMemo to get visibleProducts; ProductList renders visibleProducts
FilterPanel receives filters + onChange props; calls onChange with a full FilterState spread — never calls filter utils directly
SortSelect is a separate component from FilterPanel; both feed into the same filters state in App.tsx
FilterState type is defined in productFilters.ts: { search: string, category: string, inStockOnly: boolean, sortBy: 'default' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating-desc' }
initialFilters in useProductFilters.ts: { search: '', category: 'All', inStockOnly: false, sortBy: 'default' }
filterProducts(products, filters) is the single exported function containing both filter and sort logic — both fixes land here
edgeCases: Search term that trims to empty string (e.g. '   '): after .trim(), falsy check means no search filter fires and all products are shown
Search is name-only: product.name.toLowerCase().includes(...) — category and other fields are not searched
Category 'All' with in-stock filter enabled: no category predicate fires, in-stock predicate still applies independently
Non-default sortBy when 'Clear filters' clicked: clearFilters.test.tsx explicitly asserts sort select returns to 'default'
Sort with no filter active: all 15 products sorted — test asserts exact full ordered list for price-asc
results-count format is 'Showing N products' with no pluralization — even 'Showing 1 products' is expected by tests
Sort must not mutate the input products array — result = [...products] spread copy is already correct and must be preserved
